cases.content: Debugging note for prompt rendering: classification and tagging cache entries currently use only the memory text as their key. If allCategories.json or allTags.json changes during a long-running process, an existing entry can return stale rendered prompt content. Include the prompt version and taxonomy hash in the cache key, and add a test that changes the taxonomy fixture between calls.

source.rationale: Purpose-authored benchmark case; it is not represented as a transformation of a MemoryApi record.

summarization.referenceAnswer: Prompt-rendering caches can become stale because keys omit prompt version and taxonomy hash; include both and test taxonomy changes between calls.
